first.rationale: Prior evidence indicates signup and onboarding simplification durably improved activation, completion, time-to-value, and early adoption in self-serve/SMB accounts. This directly addresses both current declines while avoiding promotional pricing's documented 30-day retention harm. Verify the underlying records before committing because the current declines may have causes not represented in prior tests.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the self-serve/SMB onboarding flow. Verified evidence shows shorter onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%; SMB signup simplification also raised activation by 9% and qualified revenue by 4%. This directly addresses the concurrent 6% activation and 4% completion declines. Monitor qualified revenue and 30-day retention closely because the SMB signup test had a 1% retention decline, and do not infer results beyond the validated SMB/self-serve context.
